tasks.scope: Found while dogfooding (AI-Agent-marketplace PM, 2026-09-25): the Night Run started by a systemd user timer (systemd-run --on-calendar ... night start 04:00) died 90 s after launch with Result: timeout, because the supervisor detached with setsid+nohup still lives in the launching unit cgroup and systemd stops the whole cgroup when the unit main process exits. Fix in src/v2/night-run/index.mjs: export buildOwnScopeArgs(env, argv) that returns the argv for re-running the same night-run up command inside its own transient scope (systemd-run --user --scope --collect --unit agent-relay-night-supervisor-<timestamp> -- <node> <script> <same args>) when env.INVOCATION_ID is set (started from a systemd unit) and env.AGENT_RELAY_OWN_SCOPE is not "1"; otherwise null. In the night-run up entry, when it returns args, spawn that command detached with AGENT_RELAY_OWN_SCOPE=1 in env and exit 0 after the child starts, so the supervisor outlives the launching unit. Add tests to test/v03.test.mjs: INVOCATION_ID set -> scope args include --scope and the original args; already scoped -> null; no INVOCATION_ID (ssh/terminal) -> null. Do not change the deadline, report or power behaviour.

For each enabled Environment from core/sources.load_environments(), it calls fetch inside tmux.using_environment(env), in its own thread with a timeout, so a slow SSH never blocks the other environments. It returns groups in order (local first, then SSH, then WSL), each with a header like '이 컴퓨터 · 창 N개', 'ASUS (SSH) · 창 N개' or 'WSL Ubuntu · 창 N개'. A down environment gets an amber header (never red) reading '연결할 수 없어요 — 켜져 있는지 확인해 주세요' with a [다시 연결] button that re-polls only that environment, and its raw error appears only under 원문 보기. The board header reads '연결된 환경 N곳 · 창 M개'. Render these groups in the serve.py web board and in tui.py. When no environments are saved, or `--ssh T` is used, show exactly one group, so today's behaviour is unchanged. Send, copy, the live card and result-check state stay exactly as they are now: do not touch core/state.py, the result-check keys or the send paths. Also remove the pane ID and coordinates (d.target) from Founder-visible text at serve.py:304 and :366, showing only d.display. Add tests/test_board_all_envs.py, offline with fake fetch/runner only (no real tmux, ssh or wsl). It must fail on the old code, because the helper does not exist and the page still contains `${d.target}`, and pass on the new. It covers: group order and headers, the total header line, one env down showing amber plus 원문 보기 while the others still list panes, a slow env not delaying the others, the single-group `--ssh` case, and the served HTML no longer containing `${d.target}`. QA of the previous attempt (commit a37f388, grouping tests passed) asked only for wording: src/actl/tui.py showed 'live pane', 'OpenCode … pane' and 'CPU+pane tail' developer text on the Founder surface. Keep the same grouping approach, rebuilt on the latest base, and every Founder-visible string you add or touch must be plain Korean (e.g. '창', '지금 화면', no 'pane'/'tail'/'CPU'). Add a test asserting the grouped board text contains none of 'pane', 'tail', 'CPU'.

tasks.scope: src/sources/scan.ts scanSessions() calls importSessions(home) which reads EVERY Claude/Codex/other session file whole (fs.readFile), every OpenCode row and the Agent Relay state, keeps all events of all sessions in one array, and only then filters by --since. On the Founder's ASUS (Claude 1.4 GB, Codex 1.1 GB, OpenCode db 1.5 GB, Grok 1.6 GB) `juceipt scan --since 6h` did not finish in 5 min and one node process reached 1.7 GB, which with other work filled RAM+swap and the OOM killer took the machine down (2026-09-25 15:53). Fix: pass the cutoff into importSessions; stat each file and skip it when mtimeMs < cutoff before opening it; read JSONL files line by line (readline over createReadStream) instead of readFile; query OpenCode rows only newer than the cutoff in SQL; process one session at a time (parse → receipt → write → drop) instead of collecting all sessions first; same for readOtherSessions. Add a test that builds a temp home with one old large file (e.g. 30 MB, mtime 2 days ago) and one fresh small session, runs scanSessions({since:'1h'}) and asserts only the fresh one is produced and the old file was never opened (spy or fs.open count) — plus heapUsed growth stays under 50 MB.

Every claim must match what the code on this branch does today: open the code and the existing docs to check each feature and each command before writing it; drop or fix anything stale (old names, removed commands, features that do not exist). Task 1 retry: prior promotion 103daa3 stored approval_rules as booleans only, which does not meet the contract. In src/domain/worker-policy.ts add ACTIONS = FILE_DELETE, EXTERNAL_SEND, EXTERNAL_UPLOAD, PUBLIC_P-U-B-L-I-S-H, P-A-Y-M-E-N-T (write these last two codes without the hyphens) and DECISIONS = ALLOW, REQUIRE_APPROVAL, DENY. Add validateApprovalRules(rules): rejects non-objects, unknown action keys and unknown decision values; a missing action defaults to REQUIRE_APPROVAL. Add decideAction(rules, action, mode) with mode from CommerceMode in src/domain/commerce.ts: the pay action (the fifth code) is ALWAYS DENY while mode is PRE_BUSINESS whatever the rule says, so it cannot be bypassed without the Founder COMMERCIAL gate; in COMMERCIAL the rule applies. In src/server/owner-policy.ts validate approval_rules on create with validateApprovalRules (400 INVALID_POLICY on malformed) and add POST /api/owner/policies/:id/actions/check {action} returning {action, decision, mode} using currentMode(db) (400 on unknown action). Tests: unit cases ALLOW, REQUIRE_APPROVAL, DENY, default REQUIRE_APPROVAL, PRE_BUSINESS pay action forced DENY even when rule says ALLOW, COMMERCIAL follows rule, malformed rules rejected; integration test of the check route (runs on PGlite and TEST_DB=postgres).
